The code should also include a Controller class with Spice kernel loading code that is commented out. The simulation should be set up within a class called "MySimulation". The code should also include a function to access the Spice Kernel and print out the state. Finally, the code should include a main function that sets up and executes the Monte Carlo simulation, and cleans up the data after the test.
